name: engram-console-devtests
description: Dev/test-only harness for the ENGRAM Cortex console (hud-redesign). NEVER served from web/ and never loaded by the offline console. Holds the fast-check dependency used by the property tests; the runtime console has zero dependencies.

scripts.test:props: node css-tokens.test.js && node radar-geometry-pbt.js && node overlay-color-pbt.js && node fx-totality.js && node fill-math-pbt.js && node motion-structure-pbt.js && node countup-pbt.js
scripts.test: npm run test:props && node dom-hooks.js && node scan-offline.js
